ticket.description:
# KS-1227 - Wednesday's task for Ornith, VITEST, **TEST-ONLY MODE, MODIFY THE EXISTING TEST IN PLACE** (two hunks) (written 23:08 AEST on 2026-09-17)

Written from origin develop `27e53ec3aa010b50cd9b2e4a1d15cbb34605ba7d` (read by `git ls-remote`; it is the #1029 squash, KS-1180 part 1).
The test file `Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/__tests__/ks1072-the-latest-anchor-selector-documents-a.test.ts` (190 lines,
blob `d9c98320e`) was read whole; the product file `Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/routes/verification.ts` was read at
`:277-:345` (`makeFetchDocFromAnchorStore`, the tier-2 read) and `:515-:625` (the verify handler's tier lookup and its live chain
scan). KS-1227 and the #1029 tier-2 gate report (records R-1029-2, R-1029-3, R-1029-4; rows Q-D4-LEAK, Q-D4-NOLEAK, D-ENV-LIVE,
Q-DEAF-HIT) were read.

## THE MODE - read this twice

TEST-ONLY, MODIFY IN PLACE. Your diff contains EXACTLY ONE file: the EXISTING test file
`Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/__tests__/ks1072-the-latest-anchor-selector-documents-a.test.ts`, with the ordinary header
`--- a/Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/__tests__/ks1072-the-latest-anchor-selector-documents-a.test.ts` /
`+++ b/Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/__tests__/ks1072-the-latest-anchor-selector-documents-a.test.ts` and TWO hunks.
**No hunk for `verification.ts`.** Do NOT create a new test file. Do NOT copy the reference test - ignore it. The checker plants the
tamper named at the bottom into a clone of `verification.ts` and expects the new cell R1 RED by assertion, then expects the whole
file GREEN at the untouched tip.

## What is wrong (one paragraph)

`postTier2` (`:113-:130`) attaches a request listener to the stub anchor store, posts a verify, asserts the status is 200, reads
the body and only THEN detaches the listener (`:125`). So when the status assertion reds, the listener stays attached for the rest
of the file (the gate measured `listenerCount('request')` = 2 after one status red; row Q-D4-LEAK). The KS-1180 control cell
(`:133-:140`) already detaches before it asserts. Separately, the helper's witness records EVERY request the stub receives, not only
reads of this document, and no cell makes a second, non-hit request reach the stub, so a helper whose listener kept only hits would
red nothing (R-1029-4). **This task:** (E1) wrap the verify call, its status read and its body read in `try { ... } finally { ... }`
so the listener is detached on every path; (E2) two new cells at the end of the file: R1 points the live chain scan at the stub so a
second, non-hit request reaches it during a verify tier 2 answers, and asserts the witness reds; R2 forces a status red inside
`postTier2` and asserts the listener was detached. No product line changes. The counting rule is NOT changed, and the witness
message at `:128` is NOT reworded.

## Where (no product site changes - this list is informational; every line below STAYS)

- `:585` - (correct) `    const anchoringBase = process.env.ANCHORING_SERVICE_URL || 'http://anchoring:4005';` - the live chain scan's base URL, read on every verify. The tamper replaces this line. Stays.
- `:596` - (correct) the scan request itself, a `fetch` of the base plus `/api/anchors/verify/` plus the document's content hash: with the base pointed at the stub it reaches the stub as a second, non-hit request; the stub answers 404, `r.ok` is false (`:600`), and the verify still answers 200 from tier 2. Stays.

## The exact change - TWO EDITS in the TEST file (two hunks, 3 lines of context each side)

E1 - REPLACE lines 118-125 (the fetch call over five lines, the status assertion, the body read and the detach) with eight lines.
Lines 115-117 above (the `anchorStoreUrls` declaration, the listener, the `anchorServer.on` line) and lines 126-128 below (the two
KS-1180 comment lines and the witness assertion) stay:


E2 - INSERT sixteen lines after line 189 (the `  });` that closes the last cell, "a higher blockNumber still wins") and before
line 190 (the `});` that closes the describe). Lines 187-189 above and line 190 below stay (insert-after: the anchor is line 189

The twenty-four `+` lines (eight in E1, sixteen in E2) are byte-exact - copy them; do not paraphrase the titles or the comments, do
not drop the trailing `// KS-1227` comments (the two in E1 and the `}); // KS-1227 R1` / `}); // KS-1227 R2` closers in E2, as the KS-1180 control closes with `}); // KS-1180 control` at `:140`; they are part of the line), do not re-indent (2 spaces for `let`, `try {`,
`} finally {`, `}`, the `it(` lines and their closing `});`; 4 spaces for the statements directly inside `try`, `finally` and each
`it(`; 6 spaces inside R1's own `try` / `finally`). E1 writes the fetch on ONE line with string concatenation and the file's own
`jsonHead` constant (`:34`, the same `{ 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }`), exactly as the KS-1180 control does at `:137`; do NOT
keep the template literal. Keep `let body: unknown;` (the helper still returns `Promise<any>`, and `unknown` is assignable to it).
Every other line of the file stays byte-identical. The new cells read only names declared or imported ABOVE them in the file
(`vi`, `AddressInfo`, `anchorServer`, `postTier2`) or inside them (`witness`, `statusRed`, `e`).

The `+` lines contain no non-ASCII character, no backslash, no dollar sign, no backtick and no double quote. Keep it that way.

Red under the tamper: R1 fails at `.toContain` by assertion. With `:585` ignoring `ANCHORING_SERVICE_URL`, the scan goes to
`http://anchoring:4005` instead of the stub, so the stub receives only the tier-2 read, the witness passes, `postTier2` resolves and
`witness` is `'no red'`. Green at the tip: the scan reaches the stub as `/api/anchors/verify/<hash>`, the witness sees two URLs and
throws its `KS-1180: tier 2 answered, ...` message, which R1 catches. R2 is green on both trees (the tamper does not touch the miss
path; with E1 the listener count after the status red is 1). The five existing `postTier2` cells and the KS-1180 control stay green on
both trees (none of them sets the env, so the scan never reaches the stub).
